_comment: Endgame is tetelestai, and nothing else (the author, 22 Oct 2026: "Tetelestai is endgame video. Very simple").
Part I: Papyrus 66, then John 19:30 in the King James Version, typed and read. Finale: the one word over the
Pale Blue Dot, its transliteration and its sense, then the close card.
Scripture is KJV verbatim (Gutenberg #10 via scripts/kjv-verse.py). The word is said from phonemes (tetelestai, stress
on the third syllable). Two pictures, both public domain, both credited on screen.

film.credit: Stills: Papyrus 66, Bodmer Lab, Geneva (public domain); the Pale Blue Dot, NASA/JPL (public domain). Narration: Piper “cori” voice, trained on public-domain LibriVox recordings.

page_summary: Endgame is one word. τετέλεσται, tetelestai: “It is finished” (John 19:30). A perfect passive: not “it ended”, but it has been completed, and remains so.
page_links: Read the close in the report
